talk.jaymoskingdoms.captive.ask.folk: They dragged me off from %1$s and chained me here. Home's %2$s to the %3$s. Please, will you break these chains and take me back to %1$s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.captive.ask.guard: I stand the watch at %1$s. They took me on patrol. It's %2$s to the %3$s of here. Get me out and back to %1$s, and the watch won't forget it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.captive.ask.kin: Listen to me. My kin rule %1$s, and they'll pay well to have me back. It's %2$s to the %3$s. Will you break these chains and take me home?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.captive.ask.homeless: There's nothing left of my home. Take me to any town that'll have me. The nearest is %1$s, %2$s to the %3$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.captive.ask.nowhere: I've nowhere left to go. Get me out of these chains and take me to any town with walls and a watch. I'll follow you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.captive.take: Break the chains and take them home to %s
talk.jaymoskingdoms.captive.take.any: Break the chains and take them to a town (%s is nearest)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.captive.take.nowhere: Break the chains and take them to any town
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.0: Wait! Hear me out first, please!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.1: Listen to me, I need to tell you where I'm from!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.2: Stop, stop! Talk to me, please!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.3: Don't just tug at the chains. Let me tell you who I am.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.4: Please, a word! You need to know where I'm going.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.5: Hear me first. Home's a long way from here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.6: Talk to me! I can tell you the way home.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.7: Wait, listen. Do you even know where I live?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.8: Please, just a word before anything else!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.9: Let me speak! I have to tell you where they took me from.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.10: Not like that. Talk to me first, please.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.wait.11: Listen! I'll tell you everything, just hear me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.0: No... please, don't leave me here!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.1: Come back for me. Please come back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.2: Then I'll wait. What else can I do?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.3: They'll be back soon. Don't be long.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.4: I understand. Just don't forget me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.5: Please... I can't stay here much longer.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.7: I'll still be here. Chained. Waiting.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.8: My family's waiting too. Remember that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.9: Go, then. But come back, I beg you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.10: You'd leave me in chains? ...Fine. Come back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.later.11: Don't let them move me before you return.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.159: A captive in chains won't come with you on a plain click. Sneak and talk to them first: they'll tell you where they were taken from and which way it lies, and you choose whether to take them home.
